reason: I might take the free audit because it costs me nothing, but I already know which two clients are underpaying, and I'm not handing my PSA export and contracts to a brand-new outfit with no customers and no reviews, then paying £99 a month on top of the billing I already do myself.
objection: No integrations, no reviews, no customers yet. It's my clients' data and my contracts going to someone I've never heard of, and a monthly check I could mostly do myself in the spreadsheet if I sat down for an afternoon.
would_change_my_mind: Another UK MSP owner I know telling me it found real money they actually billed, and that the founder handled the data properly.
